name: Hornero Pomodoro
description: Pomodoro 2.0: compact bar focus timer with a popover, deadline-correct timing across sleep/reload, a typed session-length setting and a completion toast. No processes, no network.
author: HorneroOS contributors

deadlineEpochMs.description: Saved running deadline in epoch milliseconds (0 when not running). Managed by the timer; do not edit.

remainingSeconds.description: Saved paused time remaining in seconds (0 means a full session). Managed by the timer; do not edit.

changelog.notes: Productivity Timers 2.0: compact indicator plus popover controls, deadline-correct timing persisted across sleep/reload, typed focusMinutes setting (default 25), completion toast, Theme tokens and Argentine Spanish translation.
Bar focus timer: click to start or pause, flashing DONE at zero, then reset.
